reference_sql:
WITH product_revenue AS (
  -- one row per product that sold from January to June 2025
  SELECT p.category_id, ol.product_id,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY p.category_id, ol.product_id
),
ranked AS (
  -- one row per product, with its place in its category and its category's total
  SELECT category_id, product_id, net_revenue_eur,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY net_revenue_eur DESC, product_id) AS revenue_rank,
         SUM(net_revenue_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id) AS category_revenue_eur
  FROM product_revenue
)
SELECT c.category_name, r.product_id, r.net_revenue_eur, r.revenue_rank,
       ROUND(100.0 * r.net_revenue_eur / r.category_revenue_eur, 1) AS category_share_pct
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN categories AS c ON c.category_id = r.category_id
WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 3
ORDER BY c.category_name, r.net_revenue_eur DESC, r.product_id

WITH product_revenue AS (
  -- one row per product that sold from January to June 2025
  SELECT p.category_id, ol.product_id,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY p.category_id, ol.product_id
),
category_totals AS (
  -- one row per category
  SELECT category_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS category_revenue_eur
  FROM product_revenue
  GROUP BY category_id
),
placed AS (
  -- one row per product: its place is 1 plus the products of its category ahead of it
  SELECT a.category_id, a.product_id, a.net_revenue_eur, COUNT(b.product_id) + 1 AS revenue_rank
  FROM product_revenue AS a
  LEFT JOIN product_revenue AS b
    ON b.category_id = a.category_id
   AND (b.net_revenue_eur > a.net_revenue_eur
        OR (b.net_revenue_eur = a.net_revenue_eur AND b.product_id < a.product_id))
  GROUP BY a.category_id, a.product_id, a.net_revenue_eur
)
SELECT c.category_name, pl.product_id, pl.net_revenue_eur, pl.revenue_rank,
       ROUND(100.0 * pl.net_revenue_eur / t.category_revenue_eur, 1) AS category_share_pct
FROM placed AS pl
JOIN category_totals AS t ON t.category_id = pl.category_id
JOIN categories AS c ON c.category_id = pl.category_id
WHERE pl.revenue_rank <= 3
ORDER BY c.category_name, pl.net_revenue_eur DESC, pl.product_id

  FROM order_lines AS ol

  JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  JOIN categories AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id

    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY c.category_name, ol.product_id
),
ranked AS (
  -- one row per product, with its place in its category and its share of the category
  SELECT category_name, product_id, net_revenue_eur,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY net_revenue_eur DESC, product_id) AS revenue_rank,
         ROUND(100.0 * net_revenue_eur / SUM(net_revenue_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY category_name), 1) AS category_share_pct
  FROM product_revenue
)
SELECT category_name, product_id, net_revenue_eur, revenue_rank, category_share_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank <= 3
ORDER BY category_name, net_revenue_eur DESC, product_id

solver.query:
WITH rev AS (
  SELECT c.category_name, p.product_id,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY c.category_name, p.product_id
), r AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY net_revenue_eur DESC, product_id ASC) AS revenue_rank,
    100.0 * net_revenue_eur / SUM(net_revenue_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY category_name) AS share
  FROM rev
)
SELECT category_name, product_id, net_revenue_eur, revenue_rank, ROUND(share, 1) AS category_share_pct
FROM r
WHERE revenue_rank <= 3
ORDER BY category_name ASC, net_revenue_eur DESC, product_id ASC
